# Command line reference

<!-- Generated by `osb docs -o docs/reference`. Do not edit. -->

Global flags:

```
  -a, --arg stringArray    argument value name=value (repeatable)
      --args-file string   YAML file with argument values
  -f, --file string        configuration file (default osb.yaml)
      --flavor string      flavor (distribution): archlinux, debian, ubuntu or a custom flavor
      --no-prompt          never prompt for missing arguments
  -v, --verbose            verbose output
```

## osb actions

List and describe built-in and extra actions

Usage: `osb actions`

## osb actions list

List built-in and extra actions

Usage: `osb actions list`

## osb actions show

Show arguments and an example of an action

Usage: `osb actions show <action>`

## osb actions source

Print the YAML source of an extra action's library file

Usage: `osb actions source <action|file>`

## osb apply

Show the plan and configure the running system after confirmation

```
Detects the flavor from /etc/os-release (unless --flavor is given), prints the steps
that will run and asks for confirmation before executing the generated script as root.
```

Usage: `osb apply [flags]`

```
      --dry-run       only print the plan
      --show-script   print the full script (secrets redacted) before asking
  -y, --yes           do not ask for confirmation
```

## osb build

Build a container image, WSL distribution or VM image

```
build oci    builds a container image with docker (BuildKit) or podman
build wsl    builds a WSL 2 distribution archive (.wsl) from a container image
build qcow2  boots the flavor's cloud image with cloud-init in QEMU/libvirt and saves the disk
build ova    builds a qcow2 image and converts it into an OVA appliance
```

Usage: `osb build <oci|wsl|qcow2|ova> [flags]`

```
      --keep            keep intermediate files
  -o, --output string   output directory
```

## osb docs

Generate the action reference (Markdown)

Usage: `osb docs [flags]`

```
  -o, --output string   output directory
```

## osb flavors

List built-in flavors

Usage: `osb flavors`

## osb imports

Manage git imports and the lockfile

Usage: `osb imports`

## osb imports list

List all files the configuration consists of and the locked git imports

Usage: `osb imports list`

## osb imports update

Resolve git refs again and rewrite osb.lock

Usage: `osb imports update`

## osb init

Create an example osb.yaml and the JSON schema

Usage: `osb init [dir]`

## osb render

Render a shell script, a Dockerfile with build context, or cloud-init user-data

```
render shell       prints the script (or writes it with -o FILE|DIR/)
render dockerfile  writes Dockerfile and build context to -o DIR
render cloud-init  writes user-data, meta-data (and seed.iso if an ISO tool is installed) to -o DIR
```

Usage: `osb render <shell|dockerfile|cloud-init> [flags]`

```
  -o, --output string   output file or directory
      --redact          redact secrets when printing the script
```

## osb schema

Print the JSON schema of the configuration format

```
Print the JSON schema. Use it in editors with yaml-language-server:
  # yaml-language-server: $schema=./osb.schema.json
```

Usage: `osb schema [flags]`

```
  -o, --output string   write to a file
```

## osb targets

List targets

Usage: `osb targets`

## osb test

Run *.test.yaml library tests

```
Finds *.test.yaml files (recursively in directories, default .) and runs their test cases.
Each test file imports the library file next to it (foo.test.yaml -> foo.yaml).
```

Usage: `osb test [paths...] [flags]`

```
      --run      also run tests marked run: true in containers (needs docker)
      --update   update golden files
```

## osb validate

Validate the configuration for all (or the selected) flavors and targets

```
Validates the configuration against the schema, then evaluates it for every enabled
flavor and target. Missing required arguments are replaced by placeholders.
```

Usage: `osb validate`
